lines.speaker: Nebby
lines.text: Welcome to the Starport! See the Crown Asteroid floating over the lake? Hop the stones from the north stop.

lines.speaker: Nebby
lines.text: Or, if you have a vine, swing up from the ferry stop on the south side.

lines.speaker: Nebby
lines.text: The Antenna Tower on the west rim runs on thunder, by the way. Give its coil a good jolt.
